issues: Debug title PARTICLE SAND FILL plus two gray skeleton bars in a 2px gray-bordered card; no axis, categories or units
Rain for the tall bars fell in from outside the card, crossing the card edge and the title
The chart was a small block in the middle; the hero bar was amber specks among gray bars, with no clear hierarchy
Grains landed left-to-right layer by layer like a typewriter; value labels were small and stuck to the bar tops
changes: Look switched to paper but styled as a Swiss-grid data infographic (124px heavy grotesk title, mono ticks and legend); the content makes the technique literal: October rainfall in four cities, one rain gauge each
Rain enters at the gauge mouth: the mask fades in only within 70px above it, never over the title; 16px rounded grains in shuffled column order stretch into drops by speed and bounce 15% on landing
Palette is just ink + vermilion: record city Bergen in vermilion, the rest in ink; one shared rain rate plus a 4f stagger fills the short gauges first and Bergen last (~f97), so condensing cascades

Resolution in four beats: gaps close 2px→0, a lit solid bar takes over, 84px readings pop in on one aligned row above the gauges, dotted leader lines draw down to the fill level, then the legend's Record row turns bold
Chart spans the frame (axis to 1780px), gauges have inner tick marks and a lip; a 2% slow push throughout and ≥45f clean tail; 150→168f
